# bestsignals

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-reference.js; do not edit by hand. -->

```
bestsignals(options)
```

Searches possible signal parameters to find the highest score

### Options

| Option | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|
| `interval` | The bar timeframe for the results | day, year, quarter, month, week |
| `label` | Identifier used in logging messages |  |
| `processed_symbols` | Array of symbol.market strings that have already been processed |  |
| `begin` | Sets the earliest date (or dateTime) to retrieve |  |
| `end` | Sets the latest dateTime to retrieve |  |
| `tz` | Timezone used to format the ending field, using the identifier in the tz database |  |
| `ending_format` | Date and time format of the resulting ending field |  |
| `columns` | Column expression included in the output. The expression can be any combination of field, constants, and function calls connected by an operator or operators. |  |
| `criteria` | An expression (possibly of an rolling function) of each included security bar that must be true to be included in the result. |  |
| `parameters` | Parameter used to help compute a column. The value must be a constant literal. |  |
| `variables` | Variable used to help compute a column. The expression can be any combination of field, constants, and function calls connected by an operator or operators. |  |
| `now` | The current date/time this request is started |  |
| `offline` | If only the local data should be used in the computation |  |
| `update` | If the system should (re)fetch the last bar |  |
| `read_only` | true |  |
| `transient` | If no computed columns should be persisted to disk. Useful when evaluating expressions, over a short time period, that might not be evaluated again. |  |
| `fast_arithmetic` | If native double-precision numeric operators should be used with fractional errors |  |
| `portfolio` | Sets the set of securities or nested protfolios to collect data on |  |
| `filter` | An expression (possibly of an rolling function) of each included security bar that must be true to be included in the result. The result of these expressions have no impact on rolling functions, unlike criteria, which is applied earlier. |  |
| `precedence` | The order that securities should be checked for inclusion in the result. A comma separated list of expressions can be provided and each may be wrapped in a DESC function to indicate the order should be reversed. |  |
| `order` | The order that the output should be sorted by. A comma separated list of expressions can be provided and each may be wrapped in a DESC function to indicate the order should be reversed. |  |
| `pad_leading` | Number of workdays (Mon-Fri) to processes before the result (as a warm up) |  |
| `reset_every` | Sets the duration that collect should run before resetting any preceeding values |  |
| `head` | Limits the rows in the result to the given first few |  |
| `tail` | Include the given last few rows in the result |  |
| `id` | Unique alphanumeric identifier among its peers (optional) |  |
| `allocation_pct` | Percentage 0-100 of the balance that should be allocated to this strategy |  |
| `allocation_peak_pct` | Percentage 0-100 of the maximum balance in the past 12 months to allocate |  |
| `reserve_peak_allocation` | Amount to exclude from allocation at peak balance in the past 12 months |  |
| `reserve_allocation` | Amount to exclude from allocation to this strategy |  |
| `allocation_min` | Minimum amount that should be allocated to this strategy |  |
| `allocation_max` | Maximum amount that should be allocated to this strategy |  |
| `solution_count` | Number of solutions to include in result |  |
| `sample_duration` | Duration of each sample |  |
| `sample_count` | Number of samples to search before searching the entire date range (begin-end) |  |
| `sample_population_size` | Number of candidates to test and mutate together in each sample |  |
| `sample_termination` | Amount of time spent searching for sample solutions |  |
| `eval_validity` | Expression (or array) that invalidates candidates by returning 0 or null |  |
| `eval_variables` | Variable used to help compute the eval_score. The expression can be any combination of field, constants, and function calls connected by an operator or operators. |  |
| `eval_score` | Expression that determines the score for a sample |  |
| `parameter_values` | Possible parameter values for each each parameter name |  |
| `population_size` | Number of candidates to test and mutate together |  |
| `optimize_termination` | Amount of time spent searching for a solution before the best yet is used |  |
| `termination` | Amount of time spent searching for a solution before the best yet is used |  |
| `signals` | Array of variable names that should be tested as signals |  |
| `signal_variable` | The variable name to use when testing various signals |  |
| `signalset` | Array of signal sets that include array of signals (variable names), hash of variables, default parameters, and possible parameter_values |  |
